info.name: Electronics Store — main API and Catalog Redis
info.description: Основной smoke-набор для Auth и Catalog. Папка 04 демонстрирует cache-aside и refresh справочника брендов в Redis.

exec: pm.test('Catalog public API is reachable', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Catalog list contract is returned', () => { const json = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(json.items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(json.page).to.eql(1); pm.expect(json.pageSize).to.eql(1); });

pm.test('Admin credentials are configured', () => { pm.expect(pm.environment.get('adminLogin'), 'Set adminLogin in environment').to.not.be.empty; pm.expect(pm.environment.get('adminPassword'), 'Set adminPassword in environment').to.not.be.empty; });

if (pm.response.code === 404 && attempt < 10) { pm.environment.set('customerPoll', attempt + 1); pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName); } else { pm.environment.unset('customerPoll'); pm.test('Customer profile is ready', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if (pm.response.code === 200) pm.environment.set('customerId', pm.response.json().id); }
pm.test('Created address is present', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id === pm.environment.get('addressId'))).to.be.true);

if(pm.response.code===404&&attempt<10){pm.environment.set('catalogDetailsPoll',attempt+1);pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName);}else{pm.environment.unset('catalogDetailsPoll');pm.test('Product details returned',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));if(pm.response.code===200){const json=pm.response.json();pm.test('Correct product returned',()=>pm.expect(json.productId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('productId')));pm.test('Product contains brand, category and attributes',()=>{pm.expect(json.brand.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('brandId'));pm.expect(json.category.id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('categoryId'));pm.expect(json.attributes).to.be.an('array').with.lengthOf(2);});}}

item.name: 04 Catalog Redis cache demonstration
item.description: Запросы выполнять строго по порядку. Они не обращаются к Redis напрямую: демонстрируют cache-aside через повтор идентичного запроса и немедленный refresh brands:all после admin update.

item.name: 2. Read same product-list key from cache

exec: console.log(`Catalog repeated/cache-hit candidate: ${pm.response.responseTime} ms; warm-up: ${first} ms`);
pm.test('Response time is recorded (not used as a flaky speed assertion)', () => { pm.expect(first).to.be.at.least(0); pm.expect(pm.response.responseTime).to.be.at.least(0); });
pm.test('Created brand exists before refresh', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().some(x => x.id === pm.environment.get('brandId'))).to.be.true);

item.name: 4. Admin update refreshes brands Redis key

exec: pm.test('Brand updated and cache refresh completed', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));

item.name: 5. Immediate read sees refreshed Redis value

exec: pm.test('Updated brand is immediately visible', () => { pm.expect(updated).to.exist; pm.expect(updated.name).to.eql(pm.environment.get('brandUpdatedName')); });
console.log('Catalog returned the value written by RefreshBrandsAsync to Redis key catalog:brands:all.');

item.name: Wait for product lifecycle in Warehouse

exec: const attempt = Number(pm.environment.get('warehousePoll') || 0); pm.test('Warehouse lifecycle is processing', () => pm.expect(pm.response.code).to.be.oneOf([200,404]));

if (pm.response.code === 404 && attempt < 15) { pm.environment.set('warehousePoll', attempt + 1); pm.execution.setNextRequest(pm.info.requestName); } else { pm.environment.unset('warehousePoll'); pm.test('Product appeared in Warehouse', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200)); if (pm.response.code === 200) { const x=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(x.productId).to.eql(pm.environment.get('productId')); pm.expect(x.isActive).to.be.true; } }
const x=pm.response.json(); pm.test('Stock is active and free', () => { pm.expect(x.availableQuantity).to.eql(10); pm.expect(x.reservedQuantity).to.eql(0); pm.expect(x.isActive).to.be.true; });
pm.test('Income movement exists', () => { const items=pm.response.json().items; pm.expect(items).to.be.an('array'); pm.expect(items.some(x => x.quantity === 10)).to.be.true; });

const from=new Date(Date.now()+48*3600000); const to=new Date(from.getTime()+2*3600000); pm.environment.set('deliverySlotTimeFrom',from.toISOString()); pm.environment.set('deliverySlotTimeTo',to.toISOString());
const x=pm.response.json(); pm.environment.set('deliverySlotId',x.slotId); pm.test('Slot has capacity', () => { pm.expect(x.capacity).to.eql(2); pm.expect(x.reservedCount).to.eql(0); });

pm.test('Stock returned',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const x=pm.response.json();pm.test('Two units reserved for confirmed order',()=>{pm.expect(x.availableQuantity).to.eql(8);pm.expect(x.reservedQuantity).to.eql(2);});

item.name: Wait for no-stock product in Warehouse

exec: pm.test('Account returned',()=>pm.response.to.have.status(200));const x=pm.response.json();pm.test('Rejected order did not charge balance',()=>{pm.expect(x.balance).to.eql(Number(pm.environment.get('balanceBeforeOrder'))-250000);pm.expect(x.heldAmount).to.eql(0);});
pm.test('Anonymous admin request is unauthorized', () => pm.response.to.have.status(401));
pm.test('USER cannot call admin API', () => pm.response.to.have.status(403));
